title: An Optimization Framework for Denoising Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.22202v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Noise-unconditioned denoising learns a single score, so generation can be viewed as gradient ascent on a fixed log-density landscape. This optimization interpretation leaves two questions: do trajectories approach meaningful data, and do different initializations retain diverse outcomes? We establish both phenomena for empirical and population multi-scale Gaussian-mixture objectives. Under explicit posterior and landscape conditions, ascent converges almost surely within $O(m\sigma_{\min}^2/\tau)$ of an $m$-dimensional reference manifold with reach at least $\tau$. We derive a source--sink identity for the same fixed field and use it to prove finite-resolution regional coverage. In an affine construction, we further identify a positive-bandwidth regime where even empirical-score optimization can avoid training-sample memorization while preserving diversity at the training resolution. translated_abstract: 无噪声条件化的去噪学习单一的分数函数，因此生成过程可被视为在固定的对数密度景观上进行梯度上升。这一优化视角引出了两个问题：上升轨迹是否会接近有意义的数据？不同的初始化是否会保留多样化的结果？我们针对经验版本与总体版本的多尺度高斯混合目标证明了这两种现象。在显式的后验与景观条件下，梯度上升几乎必然收敛到距离一个 m 维参考流形 $O(m\sigma_{\min}^2/\tau)$ 的范围内，该流形的可达半径至少为 τ。我们针对同一固定场推导出源—汇恒等式，并用它证明了有限分辨率下的区域覆盖。在一个仿射构造中，我们进一步识别出一个正带宽区域，在该区域中，即使是经验分数优化也能避免对训练样本的记忆化，同时在训练分辨率下保持多样性。同一固定目标自然支持惩罚引导的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将去噪生成视为在固定对数密度景观上的梯度上升优化框架，并从理论上证明了上升轨迹几乎必然收敛到参考数据流形附近、不同初始化可保持输出多样性，且在特定正带宽条件下即使使用经验分数也能避免对训练样本的记忆化。
en_tdlr: The paper establishes an optimization framework for denoising generation as gradient ascent on a fixed log-density landscape, proving almost-sure convergence near a reference data manifold, diversity across initializations, and a positive-bandwidth regime where empirical-score optimization avoids training-sample memorization while preserving diversity.
